meaning_en: under official supervision after a conviction
quote: Because I'm on probation, yo.
quote_cn: 因为我在缓刑期，老兄。
example: Convicted fraud suspects usually serve probation.
example_cn: 判了欺诈的一般都是缓刑。
note: 刑法律语；也指员工试用/察看期 probation period。

meaning_en: restored to good standing after wrongdoing
meaning_cn: 已改过自新的；被改造好的
quote: Gotta prove to the man I'm rehabilitated.
quote_cn: 我得让法官相信我已经改好了。
example: He finished rehab and now counts as rehabilitated.
example_cn: 他做完了戒毒疗程，现在算改过自新了。
note: 形容词 rehabilitated；名词 rehabilitation。法律＋医疗两义。

meaning_en: a morally respectable member of society
quote: Upstanding citizen.
quote_cn: 守法公民。
example: His record made him an upstanding citizen again.
example_cn: 履历干净，他又成了守法公民。
note: upstanding＝正直的。常反讽用，指表现得太正经。

meaning_en: to be very difficult to do
quote: That one's a bitch.
quote_cn: 那个动作可难了。
example: That last part of the route is a bitch.
example_cn: 最后那段路可难走了。
note: 粗俗但极常用。名词 a bitch＝难缠的事／难对付的人。

meaning_en: to make you realise something is possible
quote: you really opened my eyes to the possibilities
quote_cn: 你真是让我看到了各种可能性。
example: That trip opened my eyes to how much I had been missing.
example_cn: 那趟旅行让我意识到自己错过了多少。
note: 固定搭配。＝开眼界。反义 close your eyes to。

meaning_en: to connect you with what you need
quote: I can hook you up with some pseudo.
quote_cn: 我能帮你弄到点伪麻黄碱。
example: Can you hook me up with a decent contractor?
example_cn: 你能给我推荐个靠谱的装修队吗？
note: 职场常用。hook up 还有「勾搭上」义，看语境。

word: wouldn't miss it for the world
meaning_en: absolutely would attend
quote: Wouldn't miss it for the world.
quote_cn: 这种场合我绝不会缺席。
example: I wouldn't miss the all-hands for anything.
example_cn: 全员会我肯定到场。
note: 强表态。＝for the world 也可作 for anything（无论如何）。

meaning_en: emphasising the first quality over the second
meaning_cn: （怀）孕太显了，相比之下美不美就…了
quote: these days a little more big than beautiful
quote_cn: 这几天比起好看来更像胖了。
example: Right now she's more tired than cheerful.
example_cn: 她现在是累多过开心。
note: 这是婉转说法：不好直说某状态。＝rather than。

meaning_en: to be naturally drawn to
quote: I gravitated toward education.
quote_cn: 我自然就往教育这条路上走了。
example: He gravitated toward research rather than sales.
example_cn: 他自然倾向做研究而不是销售。
note: gravitate to＝受吸引。名词 gravitation。

meaning_en: out of practice; no longer sharp
quote: You're a little rusty, but you're not seeing the upside here.
quote_cn: 你是有点生疏了，但你看不出这事的价值。
example: My C is rusty. I'd have to look up the basics.
example_cn: 我 C 语言荒废了，基础都得现查。
note: 字义是生锈的。引申技能退步。反义 sharp。

meaning_en: the beneficial side of something
quote: you're not seeing the upside here
quote_cn: 你看不到这件事的好处。
example: The downside is the cost; the upside is the data.
example_cn: 代价是花钱，好处是拿到数据。
note: 反义 the downside（弊端）。upsides and downsides 很常见。

meaning_en: inability to see alternatives
quote: You get tunnel vision.
quote_cn: 你就会钻进牛角尖里出不来。
example: Months on one problem gave her tunnel vision.
example_cn: 在一个问题上耗了几个月，她就钻牛角尖了。
note: 也指生理上的视野狭窄。职场批评常用。

meaning_en: to consider unconventional approaches
meaning_cn: 跳出框框思考；打破常规
quote: One guy thinking outside of the box
quote_cn: 就差一个跳出框框想问题的人。
example: Hiring him would get them thinking outside the box.
example_cn: 招他进来能让他们跳出框框想问题。
note: 源自玩具「外盒思考」，创新/招聘高频。

meaning_en: a thin excuse to cover something embarrassing
quote: Kind of like some fig leaf, you know?
quote_cn: 有点像一块遮羞布。
example: The donation was a fig leaf for the tax bill.
example_cn: 那笔捐款是用来遮税单的。
note: 源自《创世纪》中亚当夏娃用无花果叶遮羞。

meaning_en: allowing someone to avoid embarrassment
meaning_cn: 保全面子的；下得了台的
quote: Some face-saving bullshit that allowed me to generously accept his charity
quote_cn: 那是给我留面子的鬼话，让我好意思收下他的施舍。
example: They offered him a lateral move as a face-saving gesture.
example_cn: 他们给他一个平级调岗，算是保全面子。
note: save face＝保全面子（面子）；lose face＝丢脸。英式更常用。

meaning_en: to reduce to the essentials
quote: When it came right down to it, I didn't know what else to do but tell him the truth.
quote_cn: 真到那份上，我除了说实话没别的办法。
example: It comes down to cost per unit, not total spend.
example_cn: 归根结底是单位成本，不是总花费。
note: it comes down to X＝关键就是 X。也作 boil down to。

meaning_en: bluntly and without softening
quote: he flat-out offered to pay for my treatment
quote_cn: 他直接提出要付我的治疗费。
example: She flat-out refused the transfer.
example_cn: 她当场就拒绝了调岗。
note: flat-out lie／refuse＝赤裸裸的。也可作 flatly。

word: talk your way out of something
meaning_en: to escape a consequence by talking
quote: I could've talked my way out of it.
quote_cn: 我本来能靠说辞躲过去的。
example: He talked his way out of the speeding ticket.
example_cn: 他靠狡辩躲掉了超速罚单。
note: talk one's way into/out of sth。搭配 talk someone out of。

meaning_en: to hold them accountable afterwards
quote: I'll deal with you later.
quote_cn: 回头我再跟你算。
example: Let it go now; I'll deal with it tomorrow.
example_cn: 先算了，我明天再处理。
note: threat 或拖延义。deal with＝处理、应付。

meaning_en: minor problems of a new venture or teenager
quote: Just growing pains.
quote_cn: 就是长大的烦恼而已。
example: Early churn is normal growing pains.
example_cn: 早期流失属于正常的成长烦恼。
note: 原指身体发育痛。创业/育儿/青春期通用。

meaning_en: to obtain or procure it
quote: Just a teenager trying to score some beer
quote_cn: 就是个想弄到啤酒的 teenager。
example: Can you score us a taxi from here?
example_cn: 你能从这儿帮我们叫到车吗？
note: 美式口语。＝get。score 也指得分／刮掉。

meaning_en: six bottles or cans bought together
quote: buy us a six-pack
quote_cn: 帮我们买六罐。
example: He grabbed a six-pack and a twenty on the way home.
example_cn: 他路上买了一提六罐和一包二十支。
note: a case（一整箱）≈ a twenty-four or thirty. 美式说 pack，英式说 pack of six。

meaning_en: to get a lucky break
quote: Guess you win the jackpot.
quote_cn: 算你走运吧。
example: First interview and they hired him — he won the jackpot.
example_cn: 第一次面试就被录了，他真是走运。
note: 反讽：其实是走了狗屎运。jackpot 原指老虎机 jackpot。

meaning_en: to be competent and knowledgeable
quote: You really know your shit.
quote_cn: 你还真懂行。
example: He knows his shit when it comes to logistics.
example_cn: 物流这块他很在行。
note: 粗俗但常作称赞。know what you're doing 同类。

meaning_en: items made of glass, especially lab or tableware
quote: I used to have, like, twice as much glassware
quote_cn: 我以前玻璃器皿有现在两倍多。
example: The lab lost half its glassware in the move.
example_cn: 搬迁时实验室丢了一半玻璃器皿。
note: 不可数。ware 作后缀＝器皿（software／hardware）。

meaning_en: to crash off the road into a ditch
quote: my dumbass ex-partner drove us into a ditch
quote_cn: 我那个蠢前搭档把车开进了沟里。
example: He spun out and drove into a ditch.
example_cn: 他打滑失控开进了沟。
note: drive someone into a ditch 也可引申为「毁了某人计划」。

meaning_en: a long passionate speech
quote: All you had to do was mention the Bunsen burner and he was off on a rant.
quote_cn: 你只要一提本生灯，他就开始滔滔不绝。
example: She went on a rant about the new expense policy.
example_cn: 她对新报销制度发了一通牢骚。
note: go off on a rant／rant about。derail a rant＝打断。

meaning_en: looking refined and dignified
quote: because he thought it made him look more distinguished
quote_cn: 因为他觉得那样显得更有气派。
example: The crest made the blazer look properly distinguished.
example_cn: 有了徽章，这件西装外套才显得够体面。
note: 形容外表/举止有身份感。动词 distinguish＝区分。

meaning_en: the essential thing that keeps something going
quote: This was our lifeblood.
quote_cn: 这就是我们的命根子。
example: Cheap freight is the lifeblood of the model.
example_cn: 低成本物流是这个模式的命脉。
note: 通常不加 a：the lifeblood of。＝命脉所在。

meaning_en: to make illegal or forbid officially
quote: I thought they'd been outlawed years ago
quote_cn: 我以为几年前就被取缔了。
example: The state outlawed the practice in 2019.
example_cn: 该州 2019 年取缔了这一做法。
note: 动词＝宣布非法；名词 outlaw＝逃犯。outlawed 形容词。

meaning_en: an expression giving nothing away
quote: I don't have the best poker face these days
quote_cn: 我最近这张脸藏不住事了。
example: She kept a poker face through the whole interview.
example_cn: 整场面试她都面无表情。
note: 源自打牌不露牌。keep a poker face＝不动声色。

meaning_en: to insistently ask them
quote: He knew something was wrong with you and he pressed me.
quote_cn: 他知道你不对劲，就追着我问。
example: She pressed him for a straight answer.
example_cn: 她逼他给个明确答复。
note: 职场追问＝施压。press for details／press someone on sth。

meaning_en: the only warning you will get
meaning_cn: 最后一次警告；下不为例
quote: Consider this your first and last warning.
quote_cn: 就算你第一次警告，也是最后一次。
example: She gave him his first and last warning in front of the team.
example_cn: 她在全组面前给了他最后一次警告。
note: warn someone off／give someone a final warning。语气很硬。

meaning_en: to have the resources to act
quote: We're in business.
quote_cn: 咱们有得搞了。
example: With two investors in, they're in business.
example_cn: 有两个投资人进场，他们就有的做了。
note: ≠「营业中」。字面是「有资本/门路」。
